entities.name: Raissa
entities.description: A satyr mother of Setessa who consults a magical starfish about her son's destiny and is disillusioned with the gods.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: Raissa's feral, horned satyr son, shown as an unnamed child on this page who is destined to be a king; a vision shows him confronting the constellation gods.

entities.name: The Starfish
entities.description: A magical, opalescent starfish in a tidal pool that gives Raissa visions in return for offerings of clams, and is impaled by her son.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: A city of women and temple of Karametra where Raissa gave birth and from which she and her son were later cast out.

entities.name: Setessan Order of Midwives
entities.description: An order of midwives of Setessa who help satyr women give birth and keep a store of symposium wine.

entities.name: Skola Valley
entities.description: The satyr home, where carefree revels take place.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of the story; Raissa's visions show places that are no part of it.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The night sky of constellation gods that Raissa sees in her final vision.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: A god whose temple's ruling council includes the father of the boy Raissa's son killed.

events.summary: Raissa gives birth to her horned, kicking son, assisted by a midwife who thanks the gods.
events.quote: That anger gave her strength, which she used to finally expel him, howling, from her body.

events.summary: During her pregnancy Raissa consults the starfish in a tidal pool, which shows her twins, then the boy crowding out the girl until only one child remains.
events.quote: feeling only the presence of one child within her.

events.summary: Raissa's flashback vision shows her son fully grown with horns, destined to be a king, with worlds beyond Theros spinning around him.
events.quote: Her son would be a king!

events.summary: Raissa decides not to abandon her child to Setessa as most satyr women would, believing he is special and needs her.
events.quote: This child was special, and he would need her to fulfill the destiny she had witnessed.

events.summary: Years later, Raissa escapes a burning house with her six-year-old son, who set her bed alight; they have been cast out of Setessa after he pushed a council member's son to his death.
events.quote: He had caused them to be cast out of Setessa when he shoved the son of one of the Karametra temple's ruling council to his death from a high rope bridge among the trees.

events.summary: Raissa, walking without destination, wonders whether she is punished for not paying tribute to the gods, and her son strikes her head with a stick.
events.quote: The boy struck her in the side of her head with his stick.

events.summary: Raissa returns with her son to the tidal pools and finds the starfish again.
events.quote: Together, Raissa and her son floated into the dream.

events.summary: In the vision the constellations of Nyx turn on Raissa's son with outrage and lightning, and he rises to meet them on a cloud of red and green power with a gleaming staff.
The vision ends with Raissa's son laughing, holding aloft his stick with the impaled body of the starfish on it.
events.quote: At the end of the stick writhed the impaled gray body of the starfish.

relations.note: Raissa is the mother of the boy.
relations.quote: Raissa looked down at the pink face of her boy and knew she could not.

relations.note: Raissa's son impales the starfish on his stick.
relations.quote: At the end of the stick writhed the impaled gray body of the starfish.

relations.note: Raissa consults the starfish with clam offerings for visions.
relations.quote: she collected clams to place in the pool next to the opalescent creature.

relations.note: The vision shows the constellation gods arrayed in outrage against her son.
relations.quote: They faced Raissa—no, they were facing her son!
